title: Surreal Clockwork Frog
description: A large mechanical frog with a melting clock for a body perches on a rocky outcrop. The stormy purple sky crackles with lightning while a butterfly hovers above and a golden fleur-de-lis stands in the foreground of a lavender field.
prompt: A giant biomechanical frog with green scaled skin and golden mechanical parts sits on a rocky cliff. Its back and side are formed from a large melting pocket watch with Roman numerals. A butterfly flutters above its head. Dramatic purple and teal stormy sky with lightning bolts. In the foreground a large ornate golden fleur-de-lis stands in a field of purple lavender with a winding yellow path and distant green trees.
